title: Determination 2023/020: Compliance of the depositing and collection of solid waste (single common waste storage area, alternative solution)
jurisdiction: New Zealand: Auckland Council as building consent authority; MBIE determination under the Building Act 2004. Non-Alberta comparative record.
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992), clause G15 (solid waste), with G15.3.1(b). Edition not named in the text read.

facts.text: A new residential property development relies on a single common waste storage area for the depositing and collection of solid waste under building consent BCO10340522.
The proposal was put forward as an alternative solution for the depositing and collection of solid waste.
The question is whether the waste storage area under clause G15 provides reasonable access for depositing and collection of solid waste.

The determination describes an alternative solution as all or part of a building design that demonstrates compliance with the performance requirements, and it considers carry distance for the alternative.

limitations: The access question is for waste collection, not disabled access. It is kept as an alternative-solution case.
The record's alternative-solution argument is summarised in parts, and the parties' positions on each point should be checked in the PDF.
Owner and street address are omitted.
Applies to the New Zealand Building Code only. No Alberta applicability is asserted.
